source_reviews.src/bioetl/infrastructure/storage/target: Reviewed all maintained CLI execution routes: run, debug, run-all, workflow run, and run-composite. Debug target execution and configured or custom composite seeds can write chembl_target, so migration admission rejects them. Help, dry-run, other pipelines, and last-source batch semantics remain covered by argv regressions. Existing filesystem configuration reads retain their expressions, scopes, dispositions, and resources; no new external resource site is introduced. Eight new writer cases failed before the fix; the focused suite passed 145 tests after it.
